notes: Two routes of one saying: the first ends at هشام, the second writes its own names, so there is no shared tail
«قال ابن المثنى وأبي سلمة ثم اتفقا» names Abu Salama in one version and is dropped: a variant remark, never a route
«قال أبو داود لم يذكر مسدد» and «- وهذا لفظه -» are the compiler's and editor's remarks: left out
